description: Three sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Claude Code) adding API rate limits. Tests numbers and names spread across sessions.

turns.user: Add rate limiting to the public API. Rule: authenticated partners must never be limited below 600 requests per minute.
turns.reply: Understood: partner keys keep at least 600 requests per minute. Anonymous clients get 60 requests per minute.
Counters live in Redis under the key prefix rl:v2: with a 60-second TTL.
Endpoint group {n} stays under 50 ms p95 with limits on.
Clients see X-RateLimit-Remaining, and Retry-After on 429 responses.
SDK {n} waits for Retry-After before retrying.
Rolled out to 10% of traffic behind the flag api_rate_limits_v2.
Open: the partner allowlist still misses two partner keys, acme-prod and globex-prod.
